children: Doliveux, has been at the helm of the board since 2020, bought 20,250 shares at a price of 505p each, spending a total of £102,262.50.
OXB's share price closed Wednesday's session at 481p, having lost over a quarter of its value since the start of 2026.
After the latest purchase, Oxford Biomedica said Doliveux owns 459,055 shares, equivalent to 0.379% of the company’s issued share capital.
